title: Njiylawu Starlit ngam Yaajde
intro: Natal ina darii les asamaan jamma mawɗo, ina ndaara fitirlaaji jalbooji ina ummoo, ina ɓuuɓtoo ina njiyloo ko foti dewal tigi rigi. E nder maa, nataluuji cewɗi deƴƴuɗi ina keɓa yettoode e sadakeeji, kono daliilu laaɓɗo ina naamnoo doole mum en. Daande nde hulaani ina jogori luulndaade aadaaji ndonaandi, ina hollita Tagɗo asamaan e leydi.
clues: Mi ndaari koode, lewru e naange, mi miijii ɗe mbaawaa wonde Joomiraawo am sabu ɗe njuumtata, ɗe majja.
Mi yedditii e peeñcu ko leñol am rewatnoo ko wonaa Alla, mi noddii ɓe ndewata Tagɗo tan.
Mi yeewtidii e laamɗo mawninoowo wiyɗo ina rokka nguurndam e maayde, mi jaabiima e siftinde Alla ina addana naange gila fuɗnaange.
Mi fiyi sanamuuji ɗii, mi ɓuuɓni ɗi, mi acci tan ɓurɗi mawnude e nder majji mbele yimɓe ɓee ina ngarta e maggo.
Mi nanngaa, mi ñaawii leñol am, mbiyi yo mi mah mbaydi, mberli mi e yiite ngulnge.
Mi hismaama nde Alla yamiri jeynge yoo won cooyngal e kisal wonande am.

arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُوقِنِينَ
verse: And thus did We show Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be among the certain [in faith]. (6:75)
